This measures submitted scenario-card coverage, not implemented service performance.

key_area_passport_coverage_ratio.formula: count(key areas assigned a project-passport protocol) / count(KEY_AREA)
assumptions: This is a design acceptance requirement; future operators must maintain the passports.

stage_gate_project_ratio.formula: count(concept renewal projects with an explicit stage gate) / count(concept renewal projects)
assumptions: This measures completeness of the concept project list, not approval or delivery.

This measures design-stage declaration of public returns, not delivered public benefit.

local_review_key_area_ratio.formula: count(key areas with a local review and pause interface) / count(KEY_AREA)
assumptions: This is a design acceptance requirement; formal procedures require lawful establishment.

public_translation_rights_count.formula: count(public translation rights defined by CTP)
assumptions: These are conceptual design principles, not statutory rights.

ctp_lifecycle_stage_count.formula: count(CTP lifecycle stages from intake to retire-or-renew)
assumptions: The stages define the proposed governance and spatial-design lifecycle.

station_spatial_sequence_coverage_ratio.formula: count(key areas documenting arrival, threshold, core, public review and exit) / count(KEY_AREA)
assumptions: This measures design-package coverage, not built-space performance.

accessible_equivalent_path_key_area_rati.formula: count(key areas requiring a continuous staffed or non-digital equivalent path) / count(KEY_AREA)
assumptions: Detailed accessibility design requires survey and professional review.

day_night_operation_key_area_ratio.formula: count(key areas with explicit day and night operating modes) / count(KEY_AREA)
assumptions: Operating modes are conceptual requirements for future operators.

reversible_component_project_ratio.formula: count(key-area station concepts using a six-item reversible kit) / count(KEY_AREA)
assumptions: Component specifications and quantities require later engineering design.

comind_kit_component_count.formula: count(reversible components in the CoMind spatial kit)
assumptions: The kit is a concept-stage minimum, not a procurement list.

ctp_executable_test_pass_ratio.formula: passed executable package tests / 24 declared executable package tests
assumptions: This verifies package topology and governance logic only; it is not evidence of field performance.

ctp_executable_test_count.formula: sum(declared executable tests across the three translation stations)
assumptions: Eight deterministic tests are declared for each station package.

station_section_control_coverage_ratio.formula: translation stations with plan-and-section control diagrams / 3 translation stations
assumptions: Control diagrams are concept-stage spatial safeguards, not construction drawings.

zero_stage_gate_count.formula: count(G0, G1, G2 and G3 evidence gates in the first 90 days)
assumptions: The gates define evidence decisions before capital delivery.

zero_stage_person_days_max.formula: sum(maximum concept resource ranges across G0-G3)
assumptions: This is a concept resource envelope, not a budget, quotation, staffing commitment or procurement basis.

handover_contract_field_coverage_ratio.formula: declared handover field categories / 12 required handover field categories
assumptions: Named parties, approvals and amounts remain placeholders until an accountable client confirms them.
